title: Honeymoon photos labelled Grand Central Station, a Mandela effect

tellings.quote: And so, I'm looking at my old photos of Grand Central Station, right? Well, Google it now. It's not called that. It's called Grand Central Terminal.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts UFOs and has been studied by NASA, says his honeymoon photos from New York around 1982 are labelled "Grand Central Station", but that if you search today the place is called Grand Central Terminal. He offers it as a Mandela effect, the idea that many people remember something differently from how the record now shows it, and tells it from his own photos.
